interface_name.description: Network interface used to send and receive RIP packets (must support multicast)

gateway_ip.description: IPv4 address of this gateway in AMPRnet (44.0.0.0/8). Must be unique in the network.

gateway_mask.description: CIDR prefix length (e.g., 24 for /24) to announce for this gateway's subnet

timer_update.description: Interval (in seconds) between RIP update messages. Lower values increase convergence but also traffic.

timer_hold.description: Hold-down time (in seconds) before a route is marked unreachable after missing updates.

timer_gc.description: Garbage collection time (in seconds) before a dead route is removed from the routing table.

auth_enable.description: Enable MD5 authentication for RIP packets. Recommended for security.

auth_key_id.description: MD5 key ID (1–255) used in authentication.

auth_secret.description: MD5 shared secret (max 16 ASCII characters). Never use in plaintext in untrusted contexts.

rate_limit_in.description: Maximum incoming RIP packets per second (0 = no limit). Helps mitigate DoS attacks.

static_routes.description: List of additional routes to announce via RIP. Each entry defines a network, prefix, next hop, and metric.

nexthop.description: IPv4 next-hop address (typically an adjacent router or interface)

metric.description: Route metric (0–15, per RIP spec). Lower = more preferred.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If omitted, logs to syslog.

drop_privileges.description: Drop root privileges after startup for improved security.

daemon_user.description: User to drop to when privileges are dropped.

daemon_group.description: Group to drop to when privileges are dropped.
